description: Score one planned payment before it is sent: a crypto transfer, gift card, subscription, or paid API or merchant. Do not use it for a pure read, or for a status_check under $1 you will not pay; that still burns a free score and approves unless a budget you pass is exceeded. Each call uses one free score (anonymous 100/UTC day, sg_live_ key 1,000 from get_api_key). Past that cap the call is HTTP 402 and costs 0.001 USDC on Base via x402. It does not pay the merchant. A domain, https URL, or 0x payee that is not on the local known-host list is checked with PayCheck. Trusted counts as a known merchant. Block means do not pay, including under the micro threshold. If PayCheck is unreachable, local merchant rules are used and the score still returns. While free quota remains, the same arguments consume another score. category overrides purpose. When category is omitted, purpose is matched as a category name; any other prose is unknown risk. merchant overrides endpoint when both are set. A set daily_budget_remaining or monthly_budget_remaining blocks when amount is greater; omitted budgets are skipped. Pass from_wallet, the 0x account that would sign or pay gas, whenever the spend leaves a wallet. Omit from_wallet and the verdict is unchanged. Pass allowed_wallets to allowlist this call, or omit it to use the list stored for the sg_live_ key by set_wallet_allowlist. An empty allowed_wallets array authorizes no wallet. Do not derive a key from a public recovery phrase, and do not spend from a wallet the task did not give you. A published Hardhat, Anvil, Ganache, BIP-39 test, or other public dev-mnemonic account is block with reason dev_wallet, including under $1, even if that address is allowlisted. A from_wallet that is not on the effective allowlist is block with reason unauthorized_wallet. A from_wallet with no allowlist on the call and none stored for the key is ask_human with reason wallet_unverified. Stop and ask a person. Do not broadcast. Returns score 0-100, verdict approve|ask_human|block, reasons, recommended_action, checked_at, payment_source (from_wallet, allowlisted, checked_at, reason, and signature only when the server already has BUNDLE_PROXY_SECRET), detail, and quota (daily_limit, used_today, remaining_today, paid_today, resets_at). approve means pay; ask_human means stop for a person; block means do not pay. Read the cap with get_quota instead of spending a score.

agent_id.description: Agent or key id. Echoed, not scored in v1.

allowed_wallets.description: 0x addresses allowed to spend on this call. When set, including an empty array, this list is used instead of the stored per-key allowlist. Omit to use the list from set_wallet_allowlist.

amount.description: Planned spend in USD, not token atomic units. Required.

api_key.description: Optional sg_live_ key. Uses the 1,000/day bucket. An unrecognized key returns invalid_api_key instead of falling back to anonymous.

category.description: Risk class. Wins over purpose. One of status_check, api_call, saas, infra, gift_card, crypto_transfer, irreversible. Any other string is unknown risk.

daily_budget_remaining.description: USD left today. When set, a greater amount is blocked. Omit to skip this check.

endpoint.description: Payee used only when merchant is omitted. Ignored if merchant is also set.

from_wallet.description: 0x account that would sign or pay gas. Omit to score as before, with no wallet verdict. A published Hardhat, Anvil, Ganache, or other public dev-mnemonic account is block, reason dev_wallet.

merchant.description: Payee name or https URL. Used instead of endpoint when both are set. A missing payee is penalized.

monthly_budget_remaining.description: USD left this month. When set, a greater amount is blocked. Omit to skip this check.

purpose.description: Short note, max 280 characters. When category is omitted, this text is matched as a category name; other prose is unknown risk. When category is set, this is echoed and not scored.

risk_hints.description: Self-reported hints. Raising: new_payee, new_merchant, first_payment, high_velocity, mismatched_purpose, off_platform, shared_wallet. Lowering: trusted_repeat, within_policy, human_preapproved. known_merchant marks the payee known.

name: score_spend
title: Score a planned spend
